policy: All 2,939 included identities remain included. Source-valid input identity mappings and actual hard-check observations are recorded separately; neither a generated table nor one use case proves every branch. Browser-specific output values map explicitly to the confirmed native API. No exclusion is inferred from a failure.

nativeMapping.limits: TryCompile keeps the confirmed false/diagnostic contract. The presentation facade can retain and color literal original source. JavaScript exception APIs are not claimed identical.
Warning details are retained; unexpected reported caller callback exceptions propagate after cleanup.
Per-call dictionaries are immutable inputs. Explicit sessions transact only successful calls.
A single formula has natural width by default. Host-width alignment requires an explicit DisplayWidth.
Finite resource limits are mandatory; unlimited expansion is deliberately not an executable resource policy.

nativeMapping.api: MathDocument native drawing data + WindowsMathRenderer PNG/SVG + MathMlWriter
nativeMapping.limits: Browser HTML/CSS string modes are replaced by native output; MathML semantics remain included.

remainingAcceptance: Run all frozen inputs and source-verified edge sets through independent semantics, geometry, MathML and homologous native outputs in JIT and Native AOT.
Classify every raster difference against unchanged thresholds and retain its original failing result.
Do not promote input mappings to full compatibility until actual hard checks and applicable branch tests pass.
Full old-CPU timing, actual monitor DPI, hardware device loss and complete screen-reader audio acceptance require their separately recorded verification.
